primary_object_card.object_statement: A first Ratchet rung starts from a finite reflexive symmetric contextual tolerance, does not presume transitivity or identity, and admits a provisional equivalence proposal only when executable closure, coface-drive, plural-MSS, proof, and negative-control gates authorize it.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: Start with what the frozen contexts fail to distinguish. Do not call that sameness yet. Code tests whether equivalence is earned, measures whether a proposed refinement repairs a declared collapsed distinction, keeps all nondominated weak survivors, and holds whenever the gradient or controls are flat.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Packet A requires a bounded tolerance-to-equivalence tournament with independent encodings, controls, and survivor antichains.

The working process uses finite presentations, coface loss, drive gradients, MSS survivors, controls, and HOLD when a tooth is not authorized; this anchor is active-worktree packet truth, not formal canon.

native_terms.contextual tolerance: A finite reflexive symmetric relation induced or proposed under declared contexts; transitivity is not assumed.
native_terms.earned equivalence: The least executable equivalence closure containing the declared tolerance, with distortion recorded.
native_terms.coface loss: The count of declared demand edges that a presentation collapses.
native_terms.tooth: One bounded state transition authorized only after all frozen code gates pass.
native_terms.MSS antichain: Every nondominated survivor under named presumption axes, without hidden scalarization.

weirdness_signature: equivalence is earned rather than smuggled in
a positive local gradient can authorize one tooth while global theory remains blocked
flat gradients produce HOLD rather than narrative momentum
primary_object_card.domain: all reflexive symmetric labeled relations on finite carriers of size one through five plus frozen transitivity and drive fixtures
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: relation census, earned closure, proof receipts, plural survivor antichain, and COMMIT_TOOTH or HOLD
allowed_operations: measure frozen coface loss and drive
execute independent solver and mutation controls
required_invariants: raw tolerance is never relabeled as equivalence without a transitivity result
engine lanes cannot read peer results
positive drive is necessary but not sufficient for a tooth
zero or negative drive always holds
no LLM or council output can change a gate result
forbidden_substitutions: cross-engine agreement as proof by itself
hand-written rank as a derived weakness order
proxy or learned label as the exact relation
negative_controls: scramble demand location while preserving count
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Julia, JAX, PyTorch/PyG, z3, cvc5, and Lev are typed executable adapters. None owns identity, theory truth, or promotion authority.
promotion_locks: no object claim beyond the declared finite contextual quotient
no canonical launch from a scratch-diagnostic tooth
no terrain/operator layer before the root relation, drive, MSS, and HOLD semantics are stable
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: versioned repo packet with frozen spec, independent engine receipts, dual-SMT proof receipt, controller, validator, mutations, and deterministic Lev flow

root_constraints: reflexive symmetric tolerance without assumed transitivity

lateral_mappings.label: undirected graph closure
lateral_mappings.target: least equivalence containing a finite tolerance
lateral_mappings.kill_control: a three-node path must expose nontransitivity before closure and the added endpoint pair after closure

lateral_mappings.label: coface gradient
lateral_mappings.kill_control: reverse, null, universal, and count-preserving scramble controls must HOLD

lateral_mappings.label: engine personalities
lateral_mappings.kill_control: a clean reimplementation in another universal runtime defeats uniqueness wording

fixation_breakers: retain the raw nontransitive relation as a red result
return all nondominated closures rather than picking one by prose
treat a flat drive as HOLD

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first executable object-preservation or gate-integrity failure without lowering a threshold or rewriting exposed receipts
loop_contract.stop_condition: all code gates and mutations pass, or the first tooth remains explicitly blocked

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the tuned visible/output baseline and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard only; no council completion claim.

source_math_locks.preserves: raw tolerance, earned equivalence, coface drive, plural MSS, HOLD semantics, engine roles, controls, and claim ceiling

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: object-preservation and preregistration only until executable receipts exist; later green remains one bounded scratch-diagnostic tooth
blocked_consumers: builder execution before card and spec validation
